name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2611: A11, the two genuinely unwatched loops. His A1 ruling gates this - I DO NOT want this to randomly just connect wires to it if theres no need - and it cancelled a heartbeat once already because the lanes were leaving dated rows. So both loops were MEASURED before anything was built. _kai_closer_loop PASSES outright - 3873 lane:kai rows, all 3873 dated, so its liveness is already derivable and a heartbeat would be a second copy of a fact on disk. _engine_driver did NOT - it publishes engineAlive as a bare boolean with no timestamp, and the value only moves while the loop runs, so if the driver dies the lamp freezes at its last reading and reports True forever. control_app own comment at 15017 records that happening - mode off, engineAlive True, ZERO frames written in the previous three minutes - and it was fixed at the CONSUMER, the relaunch guard, so every other reader still trusted a bare boolean. It gets the one thing it lacked - engineAliveAgeMs, the age of the reading from the reading own clock. None means never probed, which is NOT not-alive. Proven RED by publishing -1 instead, the exact shape the console already has for eyeAgeMs.
